claimText: Amazing Grace (arranged for beginners): the hymn tune "New Britain" as harmonized by E. O. Excell (1900), melody unchanged, with our own one-note left hand
outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against the Soprano of Mutopia 1283. The old item was not the tune with smoothed rhythm, as it claimed: whole melody notes were missing or replaced (bars 1-4 read G B | G | E D | D instead of G B G | B A | G E | D D). The melody was rewritten from the Soprano, rhythm included: 0 differences in pitch, order, onset and duration, and the source matches its own MIDI. The left hand is one held note per bar taken from Excell's bass. Still Beginner (probe: computed level beginner).
